app.tagline: Run a law firm: juggle hearings, settle or litigate, grow your practice.
app.title: Docket Day
coach.1: Welcome, Counsel! A client is waiting. Tap the reception desk.
coach.2: A parking ticket. Easy first case. Tap Accept.
coach.3: Tasks sit on the Docket Rail by date. Drag the intern onto the glowing evidence task.
coach.4: Tap the clock to skip ahead to tomorrow.
coach.4w: The intern is out taking photos…
coach.5: Amber = due soon. Drag the paralegal onto the filing.
coach.6: The prep table: match each claim with the glowing exhibit.
coach.7: Now the bill. Tap Billing run.
coach.8: Spend some fees: build the library. Prep gets faster.
coach.9: Two hearings, one partner! Drag the associate onto one of them.
court.title: Courthouse
crisis.power_cut.b: No printers for an hour: filings stop.
crisis.sick_day.b: Someone is home with a cold today.
crisis.substitute_judge.b: A different judge takes a hearing this week. Check the card.
crisis.surprise_motion.b: The other side filed a motion. A new paper is due tomorrow.
err.conflict: Conflict of interest: refer or wall it.
err.desks: No free desk. Build one or move up.
err.max: That's the most you can have.
err.no_skill: They can't do that kind of task.
err.phase: Not at this time of day.
err.wall_locked: Ethical walls open at Main Street.
graphics.dropped: Graphics lowered to keep it smooth. Change it in Settings.
hearing.nolawyer: Nobody from the firm is here!
hearing.objection_help: Tap when the marker is in the green.
hearing.title: Hearing: {name}
hud.standing_info: Standing = your reputation in each practice area. It brings bigger matters and opens new chapters.
hud.trust_info: Client money held in trust. It is never yours to spend: retainer work draws from it, the rest goes back to the client.
iap.automation.d: Staffs new tasks and hearings by itself + 2 more standing instructions.
iap.bundle.d: Ad-free + Edition + Partner's Pass + Faster Days + Overnight+ + every look.
iap.comeback.d: 2 days of operating cash to restart the firm.
iap.cosmetics_all.d: Every office style, outfit and courtroom theme.
iap.court_themes.d: A grander courthouse across the street.
iap.noads.d: No more ad breaks. Rewards without videos.
iap.outfits.d: Sharper outfits for your whole team.
iap.overnight_plus.d: The firm earns up to 8 h while you're away (instead of 4).
iap.partner_pass.d: Ad-free + a 14-day Docket Rail + one more standing instruction. Permanent.
iap.premium.d: Ad-free + gold nameplate office style + one more standing instruction.
iap.retainer_relief.d: 2.5 days of operating cash to get past a slow week.
iap.speed.d: 4× speed and a quicker billing run.
iap.starter.d: 2 days of operating cash + an extra intern for a day.
intake.conflict: Conflict: we already act against this client.
intake.empty: Nobody waiting. New clients walk in during office hours.
intake.rules_help: Auto-accept small, conflict-free matters of an area, also while you're away. {n} of {m} used.
intake.title: Reception
intro.1.b: A garage-front office in Calderport, right across from the courthouse.
intro.2.b: Every client brings dates. Put the right person on each task before it's due.
intro.3.b: Prep well, pick your battles, and grow into a busy practice.
judge.dozewell.d: Tired on Fridays: −8 % on a Friday, a bit better other days.
judge.kindlebrook.d: Soft spot for small claimants: +8 % on traffic and small claims.
judge.mendwell.d: Loves a settlement: better offers, a tougher trial.
judge.quillby.d: Strict on deadlines: a late filing costs 10 %, on time helps a little.
matter.collision: Two hearings, one lawyer. Cover one!
matter.continuance_d: Moves the hearing 3 days. Once per matter.
matter.prep_locked: Opens when the evidence is in
matter.settle_d: Certain money now. A small Standing gain.
matter.traffic.0: Parking ticket on a cargo bike
matter.visiting_d: Another firm's lawyer covers this hearing. Weaker in court than your own people.
matters.empty: No open matters. Tap the reception desk.
matters.title: Matters
office.max: The biggest office in the MVP. More floors after launch.
office.title: Office
offline.body: While you were away ({time}) the firm earned {cash} on its standing instructions.
offline.title: Welcome back
prep.done: Every claim is backed. Odds up!
prep.help: Match each claim with the exhibit that proves it.
prep.title: Prep table
prep.wrong: Not that one. Try another card.
rail.drag_hint: Drag a person onto a task
rail.empty: No dates yet. Accept a client at reception.
rail.title: Docket Rail
report.title: Day {n} report
reward.billing_boost.b: Watch a short video: +15 % on today's invoices.
reward.case_preview.b: Watch a short video: see the twist of the next 3 clients.
reward.done_preview: The next clients' twists are on their cards.
reward.offline_x2.b: Watch a short video to double what the firm earned.
role.clerk.d: Picks up open filings on their own.
role.intern.d: Cheap, many hours, runs errands and gathers evidence.
role.investigator.d: Gathers evidence fast and finds the twist.
role.paralegal.d: The fastest at filings. Sorts exhibits when you skip the prep table.
role.partner.d: Few hours, the best in court and at prep.
role.receptionist.d: More walk-ins, and clients wait longer.
settings.about_text: Calderport and everyone in it are made up. Legal flavour only — not legal advice.
settings.guide: How to play / replay the guide
settings.title: Settings
shop.cap: That's the daily limit for packs.
shop.title: Shop
team.title: Team
tip.auto_continuance: Nobody went to court, so the judge moved the hearing once. Next time it goes ahead without you.
tip.chapter2: Main Street! Tenancy and family matters, investigators, clerks and conflicts.
tip.chapter3: Courthouse Row! Contract matters, a second partner and the war room.
tip.conflict: Purple badge = conflict. You can't act for both sides: refer the client, or (from Main Street) build an ethical wall.
tip.judges: Each judge has a habit. It's on the matter card, so plan for it.
tip.late: A missed filing costs a sanction and Standing. It stays on the rail until it's done.
tip.motion: Put someone on the motion today, or pay a sanction tomorrow.
tip.power_cut: Filings wait an hour. Evidence and prep go on.
tip.report: Every evening: the report, then the billing run turns the day's work into money.
tip.sick: Their tasks wait. Drag someone else onto anything urgent.
tip.substitute: New judge, new habit. Check the odds on the card.
tip.trust: Retainer money sits in trust. Hours on that matter draw from it; leftovers go back to the client.
tip.twist: The evidence is in: the card now shows the true odds.
